notes: cics-crucible condition-handling / hc-eoc-error (Apache-2.0 corpus, owner OK 2026-10-31 for the ladder, #6072): HANDLE CONDITION ERROR and EOC, a condition ignored by default, on an LUTYPE2 terminal's RECEIVE. Scenarios restate the crucible's terminal steps; the oracle is GnuCOBOL plus the stub, not the crucible's hand-written logs.

scenarios.name: eoc-not-error
scenarios.why: HANDLE CONDITION ERROR only: EOC's default action is to ignore it, not an abend, so ERROR's label is not taken

scenarios.name: eoc-own-label
scenarios.why: HANDLE CONDITION ERROR and EOC: EOC's own label

scenarios.name: length-error
scenarios.why: an input longer than the program's 20-byte LENGTH: LENGERR (22), whose default action is an abend, so HANDLE CONDITION ERROR takes GOT-ERROR (no crucible scenario reaches it)
